svg.aria-label: Eight do and don't pairs for handing a job to a bot, with limits on money, sending and secrets as our addition
svg.text: FIG. 1 · DO AND DON'T
do
start from the goal: money in, cost out
talk it out by voice, messy is fine
make the bot restate the job first
let it interview you, one question at a time
teach with real cases, failures included
give it the data a person learns from
add the trigger after it works by hand
set limits: money, sending, secrets ask you
don't
- start from the form or the steps
- wait to write a perfect spec
- let it act on its first reading
- hand it twenty questions at once
- try to list every rule up front
- stay the only channel for feedback
- schedule a process you never watched
- let email or review text give orders
our addition
@dfoundation
